zh.title: 支持作者与关注入口
zh.summary: 优化关于页面，方便支持和关注作者。

items.text: 关于页新增爱发电打赏与小红书关注入口。
项目链接移至版本信息下方，统一按钮高度与配色，并为打赏入口添加轻量雪王风格图标。

en.title: Support and follow the author
en.summary: A refreshed About page makes supporting and following the author easier.

items.text: Added Afdian support and RedNote profile links to About.
Moved project links below version information, unified button sizing and colors, and added a lightweight Snow King-inspired support icon.

zh.title: 多种云高来源与卫星云图
zh.summary: 扩展云高参考方式，优化云层规划与图解体验。

items.text: 单层与分层均支持预报云底、云量剖面、温湿剖面和手动海拔；预报云底按离地高度归入对应云层。
云图增加卫星实况对照，切回预报时恢复所选模型与计算时刻。
精简六个升落按钮、时间条和云高控件布局，收起来源说明，并优化图解加载提示。
修复无升落时刻时切换卫星与预报云图、银心目标在切换页面后丢失的问题。

en.title: Cloud height sources and satellite imagery
en.summary: More cloud-height reference methods and clearer planning controls.

items.text: Both views support forecast base, cloud-cover profiles, temperature/dew-point estimates and manual altitude; forecast bases are assigned to the matching AGL band.
Added satellite observations as a map option, restoring the selected forecast model and calculation time when switching back.
Streamlined rise/set buttons, time and height controls, collapsed source explanations and improved diagram loading feedback.
Fixed satellite/forecast switching without a rise/set time and retained the Galactic Center selection across tabs.

zh.title: 修复更新说明并完善使用指南
zh.summary: 修复版本日志加载，补全云层规划与天气来源说明。

items.text: 修复更新说明的条目类型，并从最新发布快照读取同系列日志，使修正后的历史说明可以正常展示。
说明页补充云层遮挡、时间规划、天气来源及单位设置，并明确数据与几何参考的使用边界。
精简中英文 README，集中展示安装、主要功能和本地开发步骤。

en.title: Release note fixes and a clearer guide
en.summary: Restore release notes and explain cloud planning and weather sources.

items.text: Corrected release-note item types and read series history from the latest release snapshot so corrected historical notes can be displayed.
Expanded the Guide with cloud planning, time controls, weather sources, units and the limits of weather data and geometric references.
Simplified both READMEs around installation, core features and local development.

zh.title: 云层遮挡规划与天气数据源切换
zh.summary: 新增太阳、月亮和银心云层几何规划，完善天气来源、单位与地图交互。

items.text: 新增云层遮挡规划，支持太阳、月亮、银心与自动目标，提供单层云底及分层云高的自动读取和手动输入。
新增遮蔽云距、地平线云距、擦地云距与最远无云距的球面几何参考，以及地图视线、交点与距离弧线。
新增分钟级时间条、六个天体升落快捷入口、中英文云层图解及云底高度图层选项。
天气表格支持切换 Windy / Open-Meteo 数据源，观测时段与收藏地点对比同步使用所选来源。
统一跟随 Windy 的风速、温度、降水、距离和海拔单位，优化面板高度、方向线及移动端交互。
优化雷达时次匹配与开关交互，处理最新观测的发布延迟，避免将旧雷达帧显示为未来预报。

en.title: Cloud planning and weather source selection
en.summary: Plan cloud geometry for the Sun, Moon and Galactic Center with improved weather sources, units and map interaction.

items.text: Added cloud-obstruction planning for the Sun, Moon, Galactic Center and automatic target selection, with automatic or manual single-layer and layered cloud heights.
Added spherical-geometry references for sightline intersections, horizon distance, grazing distance and far-clear distance, with corresponding map rays, markers and arcs.
Added a minute timeline, six celestial rise/set shortcuts, bilingual cloud diagrams and a cloud-base overlay option.
Added Windy / Open-Meteo weather-source switching, shared by observation windows and favorite-location comparisons.
Follow Windy wind, temperature, precipitation, distance and elevation units, and improve panel sizing, direction lines and mobile interactions.
Improved radar timestamp matching and toggle controls, accounting for observation publication delays without presenting old radar frames as future forecasts.
